_comment: Known dynamic regions of golden-v1047 (measured from two renders of the same app code, 8 Nov 2026): request_detail_*: the 'Submitted' wall-clock time in the mock booking; explore_list_light: the first card's hero photo (network image that loaded in one render and not in the other). Keep masks tiny: they hide regressions inside them. Remove once the harness freezes the clock and preloads images (P2). 8 Nov (gate run 42497373827): the clock text is wider at some times of day than in the golden, so its first digit falls left of the original box; request_detail masks were widened to the left to contain the full text (the measured changed-pixel boxes lay directly left of the old masks, same text line).
